changes: Graceful SIGTERM/SIGINT unwind is control flow outside ordinary request-denial handlers.

Launched process groups are killed and direct children reaped on stop; failed reap cannot swallow the stop and resume service.
Repeated stop signals cannot interrupt cleanup; earlier signal handlers restored after exit.

SIGKILL/crash cannot run cleanup; explicit retained-state reconciliation remains required.
lstat followed by unlink is not an atomic compare-unlink against another privileged namespace writer; protected parent directory remains the trust boundary.
